sources.researchNote: The German file gives the birth at Hanover, the death at Cleveland and the United States as his place of exile, which together turn the music director of a Berlin film of 1933 into an émigré musician of the American Midwest. The heading is taken from the Library of Congress, which spells the forename Helmuth; the German form Helmut, under which he worked before the emigration, is kept as the display name.
